name: Blades of Chaos
description: (Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:growing)(Tag:mental)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)Ares' Blades of Chaos, forged by Hephaestus in Hades' furnace and received from the moment of creation.
